skill.name: security-checklist
skill.description: Guide security reviews with OWASP Top 10 checks, secure coding examples, scanner workflows, and compliance-focused review prompts.
skill.summary: OWASP-based security review checklist for application hardening, scanner evidence, and release readiness.

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown checklists and defensive examples. I found no prompt injection, hidden exfiltration endpoint, or executable payload, but automatic local scanner use needs explicit consent.

remediation.issue: Automatic scan commands may run without clear user consent.
remediation.suggestion: Add instructions to ask before running scanners, installing tools, contacting external services, or writing report files.

remediation.issue: Security scan outputs may include sensitive project metadata.
remediation.suggestion: Tell agents to redact secrets, avoid sharing reports externally, and summarize findings unless the user requests full output.

- [ ] **Generic error messages** ("Invalid credentials" vs "User not found")
- [ ] **No username enumeration** (same response for valid/invalid emails)
- Use strong random number generators (`secrets` module in Python)

content.user_title: Audit Application Security With OWASP Checklists
content.value_statement: Security reviews can miss common web application risks. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code structured OWASP checks, scanner workflows, and remediation guidance.
actual_capabilities: Guides reviews against the OWASP Top 10 categories.
Provides authentication, session, JWT, and password security guidance.
Documents dependency, SAST, secret, and container scanning workflows.
Explains input validation, security headers, SSRF, and XSS mitigations.
Includes GDPR and SOC 2 checklist items for planning reviews.
limitations: Does not replace professional penetration testing.
Scanner commands require local tools, permissions, and user approval.
Examples must be adapted to each project stack.
Compliance guidance is informational and is not legal advice.

use_cases.title: Pre-Release Security Review
use_cases.description: Check authentication, authorization, input validation, dependencies, and headers before deployment.

use_cases.title: Security Gate Design
use_cases.description: Define scanner evidence, vulnerability thresholds, and remediation rules for pull request reviews.

use_cases.title: Compliance Readiness Check
use_cases.description: Map application controls to GDPR and SOC 2 checklist items for audit preparation.

prompt_templates.title: Review Basic Risks
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review for a small application.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my web application with the security checklist. Focus on authentication, authorization, input validation, and dependency risks. Return prioritized fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Apply OWASP Top 10
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the OWASP Top 10 checklist on this repository. Inspect relevant files, identify likely gaps, and explain evidence for each issue.

prompt_templates.title: Run Approved Scans
prompt_templates.prompt: Run approved local security scanners for this project, then summarize critical and high findings. Ask before installing tools or changing dependencies.

prompt_templates.title: Build Release Gate
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a release security gate for this application. Combine manual review, dependency scanning, secret scanning, and remediation criteria.

output_examples.output: Prioritized security review covering access control, input validation, dependency exposure, logging gaps, and release blockers.
Assessment of password policy, MFA, session settings, JWT handling, rate limits, and account recovery risks.

output_examples.input: Prepare evidence for a compliance review.
output_examples.output: Checklist summary mapping security controls to GDPR and SOC 2 readiness items, with missing evidence noted.

best_practices: Ask for approval before running scanners or installing security tools.
Prioritize exploitable issues with clear file evidence and remediation steps.
Redact secrets and sensitive user data from scan output and summaries.
anti_patterns: Do not treat checklist completion as proof of full security.
Do not run fix commands that change dependencies without approval.
Do not copy raw secrets, tokens, or private data into review notes.

faq.question: What projects does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports web applications, APIs, and services that need secure coding and release review guidance.

faq.question: Does it run security tools automatically?
faq.answer: It describes scanner workflows. Agents should ask before running tools, installing software, or writing reports.

faq.question: Can it replace a penetration test?
faq.answer: No. It helps structured review, but expert testing is still needed for high-risk systems.

faq.question: Which security standards are covered?
faq.answer: It focuses on OWASP Top 10 and includes basic GDPR and SOC 2 readiness checks.

faq.question: Does it handle secret scanning?
faq.answer: It explains secret scanning workflows and emphasizes redaction of sensitive results.

faq.question: Is it useful for Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance works with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code repository review workflows.
